_meta.description: Suggestions register - the dedicated review queue. Every proposed change lands here first with its evidence, effort, risk and the decision it needs; nothing is implemented from a suggestion until its status moves past 'proposed'. Review workflow: proposed -> under review -> needs a decision -> adopted (implemented, moves to decisions.json) or declined (kept with the reason).
_meta.how_to_review: Read a row, check its evidence links, then set status to 'under review' by editing this file; when a path is chosen, record the choice in data/decisions.json and flip the row to 'adopted' (or 'declined' with a reason). Adopted rows are carried out in a named task on COORDINATION.md.

suggestions.title: Confirm the tracking ID and run the one-link-per-product test before adding more link placements
suggestions.what: Owner logs into Associates Central, confirms shopnow047c-20 is active, clicks each of the three published Special Links once, and confirms each event reports back.
suggestions.why: Attribution is the whole revenue model and it has never been observed reporting (FLG-04, FLG-07). Every extra placement multiplies unverified surface area.
suggestions.risk: None - the site already works without it.
suggestions.decision_needed: None - this is an action, not a choice.

suggestions.title: Choose a host for the analytics collector
suggestions.what: Deploy collector/app.py (a dependency-free Python reference endpoint) to any host that runs a small service, then set window.CC_COLLECT_URL in assets/js/analytics.js.
suggestions.why: GitHub Pages cannot run the endpoint; until it is hosted, events aggregate only in the visitor's browser and true funnels cannot be measured (FLG-08).
suggestions.risk: Low: the endpoint stores anonymous JSONL and needs no database; pick a host with a log-drain if retention matters.
suggestions.decision_needed: Which host (any small VPS, Fly.io, Render, Cloudflare Worker with KV). Costs and data-residency terms differ; none is endorsed here.

suggestions.title: Set up Search Console and submit the sitemap
suggestions.what: Create a URL-prefix property for https://wingbangboozle1-lang.github.io/Prod2/, verify (HTML file or meta tag), submit sitemap.xml, then request indexing for the front page and the three category pages.
suggestions.why: Search Console is the only authorised source of query-level data; the publishing cadence is supposed to switch from editorial order to measured queries once it exists (FLG-09).
suggestions.decision_needed: Who owns the Google account that holds the property.

suggestions.title: Pick the photography path for product imagery
suggestions.what: Choose how product images are sourced when photography is introduced: (a) shoot original photos of products the site actually has, (b) license stock kitchen photography for editorial scenes only, (c) serve Amazon imagery through the Creators/PA API once connected, or (d) stay non-photographic.
suggestions.why: Decision D-13 bars generated and copied photography outright; the design reads clean without photos, but a shop page with zero product imagery is a known conversion handicap. Path (c) is the only one that shows the actual products and it requires API access (Q-04).
suggestions.risk: Path (a) needs the products on hand; path (b) must avoid product-specific claims the photo implies; path (c) needs the API decision first.
suggestions.decision_needed: Path a/b/c/d, and budget if b.

suggestions.title: Connect the Creators/PA API for prices and availability - or keep them off permanently
suggestions.what: Decide whether the site applies for Creators API access. If yes, prices, availability and star ratings can be displayed under the API terms with their refresh rules; if no, the current no-price rule becomes permanent policy.
suggestions.why: The current register deliberately shows no price or rating (Participation Requirement 2(b) and the ratings rule 6(t) as carried). A shop without prices converts worse; the API is the compliant way to show them.
suggestions.risk: API terms constrain display and staleness; engineering cost to keep values fresh.
suggestions.decision_needed: Apply or not; if not, record the permanent no-price rule.

suggestions.title: Switch the topic queue to measured queries after 14 days of data
suggestions.what: Once Search Console exists (SG-03) and the collector is hosted (SG-02), rebuild data/calendar.json's queue from the queries that actually produce impressions, keeping the evidence rule: no topic without a question it can answer from verified fields.
suggestions.why: The cadence rule already says measurement should take over from editorial instinct; this is the concrete switch, gated so it does not run on zero data.
suggestions.risk: Low; the evidence rule (D-08) caps what a topic can claim.

suggestions.title: Add a 'what readers ask next' module fed by real queries
suggestions.what: After measurement exists, surface the next question-shaped guide on the front page and the guides hub, driven by measured queries rather than the calendar.
suggestions.why: Turns the publishing cadence into a visible loop and gives returning readers a reason to come back. Waits on measurement access.

suggestions.title: Keep RSS as reader capture; decide email capture only with a privacy basis
suggestions.what: Keep the shipped RSS feed and subscribe affordances as the only capture channel. Email capture (an opt-in form) is added only after someone answers the consent basis, retention period and privacy notice questions.
suggestions.why: Email is the strongest capture channel but it creates legal obligations nobody has answered yet; RSS ships today with zero obligations.
suggestions.effort: S (RSS is shipped) / M (email done properly)
suggestions.risk: Email done casually would be a privacy failure, not a growth feature.
suggestions.decision_needed: Email yes/no; if yes, consent basis and retention (Q-11).

suggestions.title: Product pages: one per verified product, kept to the verified fact table
suggestions.what: When the shop grows past one product per category, add a page per product holding the full verified fact table, the intent record summary and the comparison links. Today each category page carries its single product, so the page-per-product step waits.
suggestions.why: Per-product pages rank for model-specific queries, but a page-per-product site with one product per page is thin; the category structure avoids thin pages until there is real depth.
suggestions.decision_needed: Trigger: second verified product in any category.

suggestions.title: Sortable comparison table once more than three verified products exist
suggestions.what: Keep the current static comparison table (fast, no JS dependency) until more than three products are verified; then add client-side sorting and a sticky column header.
suggestions.why: Sorting three rows adds complexity without helping anyone; the trigger keeps the page simple now and useful later.

suggestions.title: Seasonal module: holiday cooking guide slot
suggestions.what: Reserve one calendar slot in December for a seasonal cooking question (e.g. reheating sides for a crowd) written to the same evidence rule - question-shaped, answerable from verified facts, no gift-list hype.
suggestions.why: Seasonality is a real traffic pattern, but the evidence rule bars 'trending' claims; a seasonal question page earns the traffic the honest way. December slot is time-sensitive.
suggestions.risk: Low; slot can be skipped without breaking the cadence.
suggestions.decision_needed: Approve the December slot and pick the question.

suggestions.title: Publish a 'how we verify' explainer as the site's trust page
suggestions.what: The Methodology page ships with this build: line-by-line rules, what a fact table row requires, and how carried values keep their provenance.
suggestions.why: The verification angle is the site's differentiator; making the method public turns governance into content.
